---
name: Performance report
about: A speed regression, or a measured idea for a speedup
labels: performance
---

**Workload** (code review, prose, repetition, or your own; prompt length and output length)

**Measured** (tok/s, before and after if comparing; the exact commands)

**Environment**: JetPack version, power mode (`nvpmodel -q`), engine commit, model file and revision

**Idea or analysis** (which bytes or launches it would remove, if proposing a change)
